text:
Situation: Amlodipine besylate 5 mg tablets are not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 155 tablets (14.2 days on hand) and Corvale General holds 328 tablets (24.4 days on hand). The current product label lists Zydus Lifesciences Limited (FEI 3002984011) and a second Zydus plant (FEI 3005430968) as manufacturers.

Why (FDA record): FDA records show the first Zydus plant received OAI classifications in 2011, 2014, and 2019 with warning letters in 2011, 2015, and 2019; its most recent inspection was VAI in 2022. The second Zydus plant received a warning letter on 2026-06-02. Amlodipine besylate is not listed on FDA's shortage database today.

Our position: Supply is limited but not classified as a shortage by FDA. The warning letter history at the labeled plants creates supply continuity risk. Alternate manufacturers ranked by rule are not on FDA's shortage list today.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to qualify and purchase from Ajanta Pharma USA Inc. (ranked first); requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to qualify and purchase from Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc. (ranked second); requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to qualify and purchase from Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited (ranked third); requires P&T committee approval.
4. Buyer to qualify and purchase from Amneal Pharmaceuticals NY LLC (ranked fourth); requires P&T committee approval.
5. Buyer to qualify and purchase from Apotex Corp. (ranked fifth); requires P&T committee approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or formulary substitutions at this time; those decisions remain with treating clinicians and the committee.
